title: Computational Algebraic Topology from Scratch
text:
These notes develop computational algebraic topology from first principles. They are intended for readers with undergraduate linear algebra and some mathematical maturity, but no prior knowledge of algebraic topology.
The central idea is to turn geometric and topological questions into finite algebraic computations. In particular, we will study why
\[
\partial_k \circ \partial_{k+1}=0
\]
and how this identity leads to homology groups, algorithms, filtrations, and persistent homology.
